He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State Wildcats]]. He played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) from 2021 to 2023. ==High school career== Born in [[St. Louis, Missouri]],{{cite web|title=Xavier Sneed at Yahoo! Sports|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/players/6476/|work=Yahoo.com|access-date=April 7, 2021}} Sneed attended [[Hazelwood Central High School]] where he helped the Hawks reach a 70–18 record during his final three seasons, which included at least 23 wins each year and a 5–0 mark in conference play in the 2015–16 season. He committed to playing college basketball for [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]] over offers from [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] and [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]]. In 2016, he was a consensus Top 160 prospect by most recruiting services, ranking No. 93 by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]] and No. 152 by [[247Sports.com|247Sports]].{{cite web|title=Xavier Sneed - Kansas State University Athletics|url=https://www.kstatesports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/xavier-sneed/6405|work=KStateSports.com|access-date=April 7, 2021}} ==College career== [[File:Xavier Sneed.jpg|thumb|left|Sneed with K-State in 2020]] Sneed played [[college basketball]] for [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]], where he appeared in 137 contests. Those included 32 games as a senior in 2019–20.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Announce 2020 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-announce-2020-training-camp-roster|date=November 30, 2020|work=NBA.com|access-date=April 7, 2021}} In 2017-18 he averaged 4431 points and 1.6 steals per game (6th in the [[Big 12 Conference]]). In 2018-19 he averaged 10.6 points and 1.4 steals per game (8th in the Conference). In 2019–20, he averaged 14.2 points (9th in the Conference), 4.8 rebounds, 1.8 steals (3rd), and 1.7 assists in 32.5 minutes per game, earning an All-[[Big 12 Conference men's basketball|Big 12]] honorable mention.{{cite web|first=Quinton|last=Wash|title=Charlotte Hornets Waive Keandre Cook, Javin Delaurier, Xavier Sneed and Khalil Whitney|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-waive-keandre-cook-javin-delaurier-xavier-sneed-and-khalil-whitney|date=December 19, 2020|work=NBA.com|access-date=April 7, 2021}}[https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/xavier-sneed-1.html?utm_medium=sr_xsite&utm_source=bbr&utm_campaign=2023_02_tbl_player_college_stats&utm_content=lnk_mcbb&utm_id=sneedxa01 "Xavier Sneed,"] sports-reference.com. ==Professional career== ===Greensboro Swarm (2021)=== After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], Sneed signed on November 30, 2020, an [[Exhibit 10]] deal with the [[Charlotte Hornets]] and was waived on December 19 after three preseason appearances. On January 27, 2021, he signed as an affiliate player with the [[Greensboro Swarm]] of the [[NBA G League]]{{cite web|first=Justin|last=Trujillo|title=Greensboro Announces Roster For Single-Site In Orlando|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/greensboro-announces-roster-for-single-site-in-orlando/|website=NBA.com|date=January 27, 2021|access-date=April 7, 2021}} and averaged 8.1 points, 4 rebounds and 1.8 steals in 13 games.{{cite web|title=River Lions Sign American Guard Xavier Sneed|url=https://www.cebl.ca/river-lions-sign-american-guard-xavier-sneed|website=CEBL.com|date=April 7, 2021|access-date=April 7, 2021}} ===Niagara River Lions (2021)=== On April 7, 2021, Sneed signed with the [[Niagara River Lions]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]] where he averaged 17.8 points (3rd in the league), 4.7 rebounds, 2.4 assists, and 1.6 steals (4th).{{cite web|first=Gabby|last=Hundman|title=Jazz Sign Xavier Sneed to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/jazz-sign-xavier-sneed-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=February 16, 2022|access-date=February 16, 2022}} ===Return to the Swarm / Memphis Grizzlies (2021–2022)=== On September 20, 2021, Sneed signed another deal with the Hornets.{{cite web|title=Hornets Sign Xavier Sneed|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/hornets-sign-xavier-sneed|website=NBA.com|date=September 20, 2021|access-date=September 20, 2021}} However, he was waived on October 8.{{cite web|first=Quinton|last=Wash|title=Charlotte Hornets Waive DJ Carton and Xavier Sneed|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-waive-dj-carton-and-xavier-sneed|website=NBA.com|date=October 8, 2021|access-date=October 8, 2021}} On October 24, he re-signed with the Greensboro Swarm.{{cite web|first=Justin|last=Trujillo|title=Swarm Announce Training Camp Roster And Coaching Staff For 2021-22|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/swarmannouncetrainingcamproster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 24, 2021|access-date=October 24, 2021}} Sneed averaged 10 points, 4 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 1.9 steals per game. On December 27, 2021, Sneed signed a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Xavier Sneed to 10-day contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-xavier-sneed-to-10-day-contract-211227|website=NBA.com|date=December 27, 2021|access-date=December 27, 2021}} After the contract expired, he re-joined the Swarm.{{cite web|title=Xavier Sneed: Back in G League|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/xavier-sneed-back-in-g-league/|website=CBSSports.com|date=January 9, 2022|access-date=February 18, 2022}} ===Utah Jazz (2022)=== On February 16, 2022, Sneed signed a two-way contract with the [[Utah Jazz]]. He was waived by the Jazz on September 16.{{cite web|first=Gabby|last=Hundman|title=Utah Jazz Waive Bass and Sneed|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-waive-bass-and-sneed|website=NBA.com|date=September 16, 2022|access-date=September 16, 2022}} ===Third stint with the Swarm (2022–2023)=== On November 4, 2022, Sneed was named to the opening night roster for the [[Greensboro Swarm]].{{cite web|title=Greensboro Swarm Announce 2022-23 Opening Night Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/greensboro-swarm-announce-2022-23-opening-night-roster/n-5895692|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 4, 2022|access-date=November 4, 2022}} ===Charlotte Hornets (2023)=== On March 28, 2023, Sneed signed a 10-day contract with the [[Charlotte Hornets]]{{cite web|title=Hornets Sign Xavier Sneed To 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-sign-xavier-sneed-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 28, 2023|access-date=March 28, 2023}} and on April 7, he signed a two-way contract with the Hornets.{{cite web|title=Hornets Sign Simmons And Sneed|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-sign-simmons-and-sneed|website=NBA.com|date=April 7, 2023|access-date=April 7, 2023}} Sneed was waived by the Hornets on August 3, 2023.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Waive Xavier Sneed|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-waive-xavier-sneed|website=NBA.com|date=August 3, 2023|access-date=August 4, 2023}} ===Happy Casa Brindisi (2023–2024)=== On August 30, 2023, Sneed signed with [[New Basket Brindisi|Happy Casa Brindisi]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{cite web|title=XAVIER SNEED COMPLETA IL ROSTER 2023/24|url=https://www.newbasketbrindisi.it/2023/08/30/xavier-sneed-completa-il-roster-2023-24/|website=NewBasketBrindisi.it|date=August 30, 2023|access-date=August 31, 2023|language=Italian}} He scored 16.2 points per game (6th).[https://basketball.realgm.com/international/league/6/Italian-Lega-Basket-Serie-A/stats/2024/Averages/Qualified/All/points/All/desc/1/Regular_Season "2023-2024 Italian Lega Basket Serie A Leaders"] basketball.realgm.com. === Bnei Herzliya (2024–2025)=== In July 2024, Sneed signed with [[Bnei Herzliya Basket|Bnei Herzliya]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].[https://www.eurobasket.com/Israel/news/884633/Former-players:-Xavier-Sneed-joins-Bnei-Hertzeliya "Xavier Sneed joins Bnei Hertzeliya,"] Eurobasket. ===Acqua S.Bernardo Cantù (2025–2026)=== On August 14, 2025, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Cantù|Acqua S.Bernardo Cantù]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://pallacanestrocantu.com/lacqua-s-bernardo-chiude-il-roster-in-grande-stile-xavier-sneed-e-biancoblu/|title=L’acqua S.Bernardo Chiude Il Roster In Grande Stile: Xavier Sneed È
